method.selection: Eight bounded original repositories selected for recurrence, persistence, task-state, scheduler and harness mechanisms.
method.retrieval: Read-only shallow bare Git snapshots, pinned by full commit; static source/test/license reads.
method.execution_boundary: No assessed code installed, imported, built or executed. Validation scripts only parse this inventory and its static files.
method.content_boundary: No source bodies, full test fixtures, private application data, environment identifiers or delivery endpoints are published.
method.evidence_boundary: Observed code paths and test assertions are not passing test runs or end-to-end guarantees.
method.path_resolution: Repository-local path discovery corrected outdated path guesses; all eight requested snapshots were acquired successfully.
method.local_context: Changing general-purpose Python engine with existing dateutil dependency, temporal policy, workspace isolation, versioned operations and durable-delivery requirements. Research writes only two implementation-review documents.
method.snapshot_boundary: Default branch snapshots can include unreleased work; installed dependency/release parity not established.
